system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

The Blue Spirit actively teaches its faithful whenever possible, and you follow in its footsteps by passing knowledge on to your allies.

Choose yourself or an ally within 10 spaces of you.

If the target makes a check to cast a spell before the start of your next turn, it gains bonus Expertise equal to your Soul.

You can spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect, choosing another target if you wish.
